manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a bounded official-index case where the registered disclosure page exposes no PDF candidates.
search_queries: 入間看護専門学校 情報公開
入間看護専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
steps: Start from the Saitama official-index disclosure URL https://www.i-heiseigakuen.ac.jp/kokai/.
Run strict FY2026 PDF discovery from the prefecture_aggregator SchoolSite.
Record the no_candidates_found evidence row instead of treating the site as crawler success.
Keep the school in the operator-visible manual queue because no target confirmation PDF was discoverable from the official entry.

reusable_rules: Treat no_candidates_found as a first-class discovery outcome when the official-index URL was crawled successfully.
Do not continue into unbounded SERP fallback from a bounded gold-set run.
Surface the school as manual-required with the official disclosure URL attached.
anti_patterns: Do not count an official-index URL as PDF acquisition success when it exposes no PDF candidates.
Do not fabricate a PDF URL from the school root page.

evidence.notes: Current-code Saitama RCA on 2026-05-11 crawled the prefecture_aggregator URL and produced one no_candidates_found evidence row for school_id 760.
